title: Commonwealth Gas Company files for review and approval an agreement for quasi-firm transportation service with Allegro Microsystem, Inc.
filings: The Agreement is hereby Approved. The Department also finds that information regarding the pricing terms and minimum quantity of terms to be purchased under the Agreement is competitively sensitive, and therefore, grants th Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Signed by: Janet Gail Besser, Chair;John D. Patrone, James Connelly, W. Robert Keating and Paul B. Vasington, Commissioners.
